visualCharacteristics: Full-bleed parallax image with dark gradient veil and the H1 on it, lead text and CTA/contact buttons below (on the image from 1440); plain variant is ink text on white without an image.
contentPattern: One cell per row, classified by content: picture(s) (desktop 16:9, optional mobile 2:3), eyebrow paragraph before the heading, h1/h2 headline, lead paragraph(s), link paragraph = CTA, bold-only paragraph = contact-dialog button.
usage: Use as the top hero of a page with a large background image, headline, short lead and call-to-action.
reuseGuidance: Reuse at the top of brand, solution and case-study pages; choose solution or case-study plus a veil option to match the page type.
